name: latex-paste-figure
description: Overleaf-style Ctrl+V: pasting an image into a .tex file saves it and inserts a figure environment.
//: Must run in the container: the provider writes the image into the workspace.

pasteFigure.directory.markdownDescription: Folder the pasted image is written to, relative to the workspace root. Created on demand.

pasteFigure.template.markdownDescription: Lines inserted at the cursor, in [snippet syntax](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/userdefinedsnippets#_snippet-syntax). `$IMAGE` is replaced by the path of the saved image; `${1:...}` are the tab stops you cycle through with `Tab`.
